HARLEYSVILLE INSURANCE 
H A R L E Y S V I L L E  I N S U R A N C E  C O M P A N Y  
 
CALIFORNIA 
COMMERCIAL MULTI-PERIL 
ACTUARIAL EXPLANATORY MEMORANDUM 
Harleysville Insurance proposes to revise our Commercial Multi-Peril program in the state of California as described 
below and in the attached exhibits. We propose a November 1, 2016 effective date for these revisions. 
 
The total commercial multi-peril rate effect for this filing is -4.0%. 
 
Specifically, we propose to make the following revisions: 
 
1. Adopt the following previously deferred ISO commercial multi-peril related reference filings: 
 
ISO Reference Filing Description 
 
ISO Reference Filing Number 
Loss Costs  
 
 
 
GL-2013-BGL1 
Loss Costs  
 
 
 
CF-2013-RLA1 
Loss Costs  
 
 
 
CF-2012-RLA1 
Loss Costs  
 
 
 
CF-2011-RLA1 
Loss Costs  
 
 
 
CF-2010-RLA1 
Loss Costs  
 
 
 
CR-2007-RLA1 
EQ Loss Costs/Rules 
 
 
CF-2013-RZPEQ 
EQ Loss Costs/Rules 
 
 
CF-2011-RZPEQ 
ILFs 
 
 
 
 
GL-2014-IALL1 
ELPs 
 
 
 
 
GL-2010-OELP1 
Rules 
 
 
 
 
GL-2014-RDD14 
Rules 
 
 
 
 
GL-2010-OCT10 
Rules 
 
 
 
 
CF-2009-RRU09* 
Rules 
 
 
 
 
CF-2009-RRU09(S3)* 
Rules 
 
 
 
 
CF-2009-RLC09 
Rules 
 
 
 
 
CF-2009-RLC09(A) 
Rules 
 
 
 
 
CF-2011-ORU1 
* Note: ISO Rule “A#: Transition Rule – Limit of Insurance Relativities and Related Change” does not apply. Please refer to #3 
below for additional information regarding Harleysville’s proposed transition rule. 
 
 
 
2. Make no changes to our currently filed and approved loss cost multipliers and package modification factors. 
 
Note that we have not written one full year’s worth of premium. As a result, the attached Prior Approval Rate 
Application form displays no premium in the most recent year.
